column2: The liberation of the city was celebrated with music in the streets.
column3: 街頭用音樂來慶祝這座城市的解放。
column5: liber 自由 + ation → 變得自由

column2: A white limo waited outside the hotel to take the bride to the church.
column3: 一輛白色大轎車停在飯店外，等著送新娘去教堂。
column4: rent a limo (租一輛大轎車)
column5: limo 是 limousine 的縮寫，砍掉後半的豪華長車

column2: The singer arrived at the awards show in a black limousine.
column3: 歌手搭著一輛黑色豪華轎車抵達頒獎典禮。
column5: limousine 念「利摩精」：加長型豪華禮車

column2: The ocean liner sailed from Keelung to Japan with a thousand passengers.
column3: 這艘遠洋班輪載著一千名乘客從基隆駛往日本。
column5: line 航線 + er → 走固定航線的大船

column2: The linguist studied how children learn two languages at once.
column3: 這位語言學者研究孩子如何同時學會兩種語言。
column4: work as a linguist (擔任語言學者)
column5: lingua 舌頭或語言 + ist 人 → 研究語言的人

column2: The tag liquidcrystaldisplay on the box means the television uses an LCD screen.
column3: 盒子上標示 liquidcrystaldisplay，表示這台電視使用液晶顯示螢幕。
column5: liquid 液體 + crystal 水晶 + display 顯示 → 簡稱 LCD
column7: liq - uid crys - tal dis - play

column2: She bought a one-liter bottle of water for the hike.
column3: 她買了一瓶一公升的水帶去健行。
column4: a liter of milk (一公升牛奶)
column5: liter 念「里特」：一公升的瓶子，別和 litter 垃圾混淆

column2: Reading programs improved literacy in the poor villages.
column3: 閱讀計畫提升了貧困村莊的讀寫能力。
column5: liter 字母 + acy → 會認字母、讀寫的能力

column2: Eating well and staying active may lead to greater longevity.
column3: 吃得健康又保持活動，可能讓人更長壽。
column5: long 長 + ev 年歲 → 活得長久

column2: The earthquake had a magnitude of 6.0 on the scale.
column3: 這場地震的規模達到芮氏六點零。
column5: magni 大 + tude → 大的程度，像 magnify 放大

column2: Her mastery of the piano surprised even her teacher.
column3: 她對鋼琴的精通連她的老師都感到驚訝。
column5: master 大師 + y → 像大師一樣精通

column2: Critics say that materialism makes people care more about buying things than about people.
column3: 批評者說，物質主義讓人更在乎買東西，而不是在乎人。
column5: material 物質 + ism 主義 → 物質至上的主義

column2: The mechanism inside the clock moves the hands at the same speed.
column3: 時鐘內部的機械裝置讓指針以相同速度移動。
column5: mechanic 機械 + ism → 機械的運作結構

column2: The doctor told her to take the medication twice a day.
column3: 醫生要她一天吃兩次藥。
column5: medic 醫 + ation → 醫治用的藥物

column2: A positive mentality helps athletes recover from defeat.
column3: 正向的心態能幫助運動員從失敗中重新站起來。
column5: mental 心理的 + ity → 心理狀態

column2: The yearly migration of geese passes over our town in October.
column3: 每年十月，鵝群的遷徙都會飛越我們的小鎮。
column5: migrate 遷移 + ion → 大遷徙

column2: The modernization of the railway cut the trip from four hours to two.
column3: 鐵路現代化後，車程從四小時縮短為兩小時。
column5: modern 現代 + ization 化 → 現代化

column2: The monotony of copying numbers all day made him sleepy.
column3: 整天抄寫數字的單調讓他昏昏欲睡。
column5: mono 單一 + tony 音調 → 同一個音調 → 單調

column2: Teachers often discuss morality through stories about honesty and kindness.
column3: 老師常透過關於誠實與善良的故事來討論道德。
column5: moral 道德的 + ity；寓言的 moral 就是寓意

column2: Our school motto is "Honesty and Effort," printed above the gate.
column3: 我們的校訓是「誠實與努力」，印在校門上方。
column5: motto 念「馬投」：把一句話投進心裡當座右銘

column2: The trumpet player cleaned the mouthpiece before every show.
column3: 小號手每場演出前都會清潔吹口。
column5: mouth 嘴 + piece 一件 → 嘴碰的那一塊；也指替人發聲的代言人

column2: The narrator of the audiobook has a warm, calm voice.
column3: 這本有聲書的敘述者聲音溫暖又平靜。
column5: narrate 敘述 + or 人 → 講故事的人

column2: Strong nationalism led some countries to put their own interests first.
column3: 強烈的民族主義讓一些國家把自身利益擺在第一。
column4: rise of nationalism (民族主義的興起)
column5: nation 國家 + al + ism 主義 → 國家至上的主義

column2: The naturalist spent years recording birds and plants in the rainforest.
column3: 這位博物學家花了多年記錄雨林裡的鳥類與植物。
column4: become a naturalist (成為博物學家)
column5: nature 大自然 + ist 人 → 研究大自然的人

column2: The baby's navel is the small mark left where the cord was once attached.
column3: 寶寶的肚臍是臍帶曾經連著的地方留下的小痕跡。
column5: navel 念「內佛」，肚臍在正中央；臍橙頂部也有一個

column2: GPS navigation helped the driver find the way through the unfamiliar city.
column3: 衛星導航幫助駕駛人在陌生的城市裡找到路。
column5: nav 船 + ig 駕駛 → 開船找方向 → 導航

column2: Bright neon signs lit up the street at night.
column3: 明亮的霓虹燈招牌在夜裡照亮了街道。
column5: neon 念「尼昂」，音近「霓虹」，夜裡亮晶晶的招牌

column2: The newlyweds spent their honeymoon hiking in the mountains.
column3: 這對新婚夫婦在山中健行度蜜月。
column5: newly 剛剛 + wed 結婚 → 剛結婚的人

column2: The newscaster read the headlines in a calm, clear voice.
column3: 新聞播報員用平靜清晰的聲音念出頭條。
column5: news 新聞 + cast 播送 → 播送新聞的人

column2: Her nomination for class president surprised her quiet friends.
column3: 她被提名競選班長，讓安靜的朋友們很驚訝。
column5: nomin 名字 → 把名字報上去 → 提名

column2: Each nominee gave a short speech before the vote.
column3: 投票前，每位被提名人都發表了簡短的演說。
column5: nominate 提名 + ee 被…的人 → 被提名的人

column2: Wearing uniforms is the norm in most Taiwanese schools.
column3: 穿制服是大多數台灣學校的常態。
column5: norm 像 normal：正常就是大家遵守的規範

column2: Plants get nourishment from the soil, water, and sunlight.
column3: 植物從土壤、水和陽光中獲得養分。
column5: nourish 滋養 + ment → 養分；和 nurse 照顧同家族

column2: The barking dog next door is a real nuisance at night.
column3: 隔壁的狗晚上亂叫，真的很討人厭。
column5: nuisance 念「牛森斯」：像隔壁亂叫的狗，真討厭

column2: Good nutrition helps children grow strong and think clearly.
column3: 良好的營養幫助孩子長得強壯、思路清楚。
column5: nutri 滋養 + tion → 吃進去的養分，像 nurse 餵養

column2: Villagers placed fruit as an offering at the temple altar.
column3: 村民把水果擺在廟裡的供桌上當供品。
column5: offer 奉上 + ing → 奉上的東西，供品

column2: There was strong opposition to the plan to cut down the old trees.
column3: 許多人強烈反對砍掉老樹的計畫。
column4: opposition to the plan (反對該計畫)
column5: op 對著 + pose 擺 → 擺在對面 → 反對

column2: Waiting in the cold for six hours was an ordeal for the whole family.
column3: 在寒冷中等六小時，對全家人來說是一場嚴酷的考驗。
column4: go through an ordeal (經歷嚴苛考驗)
column5: or + deal：不撐過去就放棄，面對一場艱難的考驗

column2: The judges praised the originality of her paintings.
column3: 評審稱讚她畫作的獨創性。
column5: origin 起源 + ality → 從源頭來、前所未有的獨創
column7: o - rig - i - nal - i - ty

column2: An outbreak of flu closed the school for a week.
column3: 流感爆發使學校停課一週。
column5: out 外面 + break 衝破 → 衝出來 → 爆發
